description:
As a leading software and consulting provider in the local government sector, we have spent over three decades applying our expertise to support public administrations and institutions in their transition toward becoming modern, efficient service organizations.

We are seeking a Software Developer to help implement new requirements and maintain our existing ERP solution.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Participate in the full implementation lifecycle of our products—from analysis to delivery—following Agile methodologies.
  • Identify suitable technical solutions using Microsoft and other web technologies such as AL Language, C#, React.
  • Develop, test, and maintain applications in alignment with internal standards and guidelines.
  • Contribute to the development of innovative e-Government solutions within a creative and collaborative team.
  • Demonstrate openness and enthusiasm for learning new technologies.

Job Requirements:

  • Graduate of an IT university program or currently in the final year of study.
  • Solid understanding of procedural programming.
  • Good knowledge of relational databases and best practices.
  • Proficient English skills (written and spoken).
  • Basic SQL knowledge.
  • Strong communication and teamwork abilities.
  • Eagerness to learn and grow professionally.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with one or more of the following: Microsoft Dynamics NAV / Dynamics 365 / Business Central, C#, .NET

What Axians Infoma Romania Offers:

  • Specialized training in new technologies and internal processes.
  • A dedicated mentor to support your professional development.
  • Opportunities to travel abroad for ongoing projects.
  • Performance-based variable bonuses.
  • Private healthcare services.
  • Additional vacation days based on seniority.
  • Regular team events.
  • Access to the VINCI Group savings plan (Castor), enabling employees to build a savings portfolio through VINCI shares.
